name: A Cup For All Seasons
source:
When counting down the days of the new season and your cafe's end, will you be able to leave a lasting bond with your most beloved customer and move on well?

[from [url=https://mxrandom1401.itch.io/a-cup-for-all-seasons]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新季節即將到來，你的咖啡館也將結束營業。在倒數的日子裡，你能否與最珍愛的顧客留下長久的羈絆，順利邁向下一段人生？

[摘自[url=https://mxrandom1401.itch.io/a-cup-for-all-seasons]itch.io[/url]]
